Read the diagram: Good visuals alone do not guarantee successful task completion.

Before: Red border only on invalid email.
After: Label + clear error + focus + retry path.
Expected result: The improved design explains what to fix and supports keyboard users.

Interview question: Can good UI still have bad UX?
Answer: Yes. Beautiful screens can still be hard to navigate or use.
